prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: pixel-art Rhubarb mouth atlas, record084 HAPPY
Input images: Image 1: the supplied 3x3 original lower-face reference grid is the EDIT TARGET. Keep its exact full-half framing, cell boundaries, mouth size, nose, chin, hair, skin, and pixel scale. Image 2: original portrait is identity and muted brown palette reference.
Primary request: Replace the mouth pose in each cell to produce a clearly readable, natural HAPPY speaking atlas. Preserve the exact 3x3 grid and row-major Rhubarb order A B C / D E F / G H X. Happy expression is a subtle consistent upward corner tension; do not change the phonetic pose family or enlarge the lips. Exact letter definitions:
A — closed lips with light pressure (P, B, M).
B — slightly open, nearly together teeth; narrow horizontal opening (most consonants, EE).
C — medium open mouth with relaxed unrounded lips (EH, AE).
D — wide vertical opening, visibly larger opening than C (AA).
E — slightly rounded lips; opening no wider than C (AO, ER).
F — puckered rounded lips with a small forward opening; no tooth bite (UW, OW, W).
G — upper teeth touch lower lip; not a wide open vowel (F, V).
H — tongue raised behind upper teeth; opening between C and D; tongue may be invisible at native scale (long L).
X — closed relaxed idle lips (silence).
Style/medium: faithful low-resolution pixel art matching this portrait; muted brown skin and lips, golden wavy hair, soft contrast and original pixel clusters.
Constraints: Edit mouth pose only. Keep same original lip and jaw scale, unchanged nose/chin/neck/hair/background and exact crop. A and X stay closed; all nine forms visibly follow their defined shape while keeping gentle HAPPY corner tension. Teeth/cavity colors remain subdued and small.
Avoid: assigning pose meanings to the wrong letters; nine grins or repeated closed mouths; F as tooth bite; G as wide open vowel; H as generic grin; red lipstick, orange skin halo, bright glaring teeth, harsh contrast, enlarged lips/head, any text, labels, gutters, borders or watermark.
